page.content:
Research wiki that documents origins, spreads, and derivatives of internet memes.

How Know Your Meme connects

  • Topic: Meme history — Know Your Meme became the reference desk of internet meme history.
  • Work: Lolcats — Know Your Meme documented lolcats as a type specimen of the image macro.
  • Work: Rickroll — Know Your Meme's rickroll entry is a standard origin write-up.

What is Know Your Meme?

Know Your Meme, launched in 2008, became the default citation for 'where did this image come from,' a folklore archive with entries, confirmation, and research staff.

Key threads lead to Meme history, Lolcats and Rickroll.
